tasks.title: Fix road-kind mismatch between core._road_kind and traffic.HEADWAY
tasks.detail: core._road_kind() emits arterial|collector|residential, but traffic.HEADWAY keys are arterial|avenue|street|lane. 'collector' and 'residential' silently fall back to 'street', so headway differentiation is partly dead. Align the vocabularies in one place.

tasks.title: Window interior parallax (critique 2)
tasks.detail: Glass is a flat quad so windows read as decals at eye level. Add a parallax interior shader or shallow recessed interior boxes with a depth cue.

tasks.title: Ground-floor shopfront variety (critique 3)
tasks.detail: Shopfronts repeat the same bay width and awning depth on every block. Vary bay rhythm, awning depth/colour, stall-riser height, security shutters and recessed entrances.

tasks.title: Construction sequencing (critique 4)
tasks.detail: Cranes exist but nothing is half-built. Add buildings under construction: exposed slabs, formwork, scaffold wrap, material lay-down areas, site hoarding.

tasks.title: Elevated highway ramps, gantries, expansion joints (critique 10)
tasks.detail: The elevated highway is a clean toy: no on/off ramps, no signage gantries, no expansion-joint noise, no pier variation.

tasks.title: Puddle reflections (critique 9)
tasks.detail: Puddles are flat discs that do not reflect. Give them a proper low-roughness layer and enable the reflection path for the active engine.

tasks.title: Canopy variety for street trees (critique 7)
tasks.detail: Street trees are evenly spaced with three repeating silhouettes. Add spacing jitter, species mix by district, seasonal/health variation and some missing or stumped slots.

tasks.title: Render performance pass: LOD + instancing audit
tasks.detail: A 900 m city is 3.7M triangles and renders slowly on CPU. Audit which collections dominate, push far geometry to LOD proxies, and confirm every repeated object is a linked duplicate rather than a copy.

tasks.title: Pedestrian variety: gait, props, groups
tasks.detail: people.py has 14 silhouettes in 5 poses. Add carried props (bags, umbrellas, strollers), grouped conversations facing each other, children scaled correctly, and wheelchair/bike users.

notes.text: people.py now has 33 silhouettes across 8 poses x 4 age classes (adult/teen/child/toddler with real head-to-height ratios, not scaled adults) and 5 carried props (bag, backpack, briefcase, umbrella, cup). Gait phase added so walkers spread across the stride cycle instead of sharing one frozen pose. Conversation groups face their circle centre; adults walk children beside them; people at crossings face the road; cyclists align to the road axis with pedal-offset legs; wheelchair and pram users included. Prop materials registered locally in people.py, not core.PALETTE, to avoid a table conflict with other agents. Verified: 459 instances, 29 distinct silhouettes used, heights 0.89-2.04 m, 13 percent children or shorter.
